name: Current Market Valuation
description: A small independent site of long-term U.S. stock-market valuation and recession-indicator models (Buffett Indicator, CAPE, price/sales, an interest-rate model, a mean-reversion model, an earnings-yield gap, the yield curve, the Sahm Rule, and others), each framed as a current reading's standard-deviation distance from its own historical norm. Used here as a design/framing reference for how a small dashboard site presents a battery of "is the market over/undervalued" models side by side.

notes: The core set of valuation and recession-indicator models is free and updates quarterly.
A paid membership adds weekly (instead of quarterly) updates across all models, interactive graphs and correlation data, and a members-only aggregate valuation model; a 7-day free trial is offered.
